title: State Theatre Center for the Arts

services.name: Facility Rentals
services.desc: The State Theatre Center for the Arts, Inc. presents a wide variety of arts and entertainment events of its own, and also welcomes requests to lease the facilities from community organizations, businesses and other users. A rare survivor from America’s grand Vaudeville era, the State Theatre was designed in a style inspired by the Davanzanti Palace in Florence with interior appointments by the legendary Italian artist, Batiste. Painstakingly restored to its original beauty in the early 1990s, the 1500 seat theatre is the perfect space for the most grand event of any size.
